gloss: slipped disc; strained back; acute lower back pain

definitions.gloss: slipped disc; strained back; acute lower back pain
definitions.explanation: sudden severe lower back pain, often caused by lifting something heavy or making an awkward movement

examples.japanese: {重|おも}い{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}ってぎっくり{腰|ごし}になった。
examples.english: I threw out my back lifting a heavy load.

examples.japanese: ぎっくり{腰|ごし}で{動|うご}けない。
examples.english: I can't move because of my strained back.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}がぎっくり{腰|ごし}で{入院|にゅういん}した。
examples.english: My father was hospitalized with a slipped disc.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The word ぎっくり is onomatopoeic, representing the sudden shock or snap felt when the back gives out.

MEDICAL TERM:
{急性腰痛症|きゅうせいようつうしょう} (acute lower back pain) is the formal medical term.

ALTERNATIVE NAME:
Also called 「{魔女|まじょ}の{一撃|いちげき}」 (witch's strike) in German-influenced medical terminology, similar to the German term "Hexenschuss."

PREVENTION:
- {正|ただ}しい{姿勢|しせい}で{物|もの}を{持|も}つ (lift with proper posture)
- {腰|こし}を{鍛|きた}える (strengthen the lower back)
